testcase.name: a line in the box beats the cell under the finger
hits only on untappable or unknown layers win nothing, and no hits win nothing
a marker in the box beats the cell under the finger
a colour field wins only when no marker or line is hit
a sighting tap names its observation, and nothing tapped is a plain tap
within the markers the layer drawn on top wins
a cell under the finger with nothing else near wins
a marker wins over a line whichever order the hits arrive in
within the lines the layer drawn on top wins
within one layer the first hit the query returned wins
a feature with no id is reported as unidentified
at the edge of a cell area a cell only in the box never wins
nothing under the point or in the box wins nothing
what lies under the point decides, and the box is not queried
the tap box is 48dp square, the minimum touch target
a feature tap is a feature tap and nothing else
a marker under the finger still wins without the box being queried, with a cell under it too
with nothing tappable under the point the box decides
every record marker, line and colour field is queried, never a casing, the offline fill, the search centre or the recording trail
the offline outline is a line - it loses to a marker and wins over nothing tappable
